operation_proposals.source_operation: Characteristic Direction differential gene-expression signature computation
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog primitives can normalize, rank, or select values, but none represents the multivariate statistical computation producing a differential-expression signature.
Ranking and selection can consume scores, but no catalog primitive computes the compound-phenotype matching score.

operation_proposals.source_operation: E-distance computation between perturbed and control cells
